messages:
sam_k: FYI onboarding sampleapp failing under json-mode when tool returns a top-level array. getting schema validation errors from the JS SDK helper.
maria: ahh can you paste the exact tool output + schema you used?
sam_k: minimal repro below. tool emits:
```json
[ {
  "id": 1,
  "text": "ok"
} ]
```
registered schema in samplekit:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": { "id": {"type":"integer"}, "text": {"type":"string"} },
  "required": ["id","text"]
}
```
maria: so schema expects an object but the tool returned an array. wasn't there some helper that auto-unpacked single-element arrays?
alex: parity bug. python helper historically tolerated single-item arrays and coerced them into objects; JS helper validates strictly and fails. that's why python sample apps didn't throw.
jin: we also saw a second issue where the retry middleware stringifies results on 5xx recoveries: it ends up passing a string like "[ ... ]" into the validator. so two surprises: array vs object + stringified-json.
sam_k: yep. our retry branch had a `return JSON.stringify(result)` left over from an earlier debug change; that interacts badly with schema validation and coercion.
maria: mitigation options: (A) loosen schemas in sampleapp to accept array OR object; (B) change JS helper to mimic python auto-unpack behavior; (C) fix the retry middleware to avoid stringify.
alex: long term do (B) + (C). (A) is a bandaid that hides mismatches. i'll draft a JS helper change that normalizes raw fncall outputs: if typeof value === 'string' try parse; if parsed is array and schema.type === 'object' && parsed.length === 1 then take parsed[0]. also add strict assertion logs so we can flip on verbose debug.
jin: small util idea: `normalizeFnResult(raw, schema)` -> if typeof raw === 'string' -> try JSON.parse, if Array.isArray(v) && schema.type === 'object' && v.length === 1 -> v = v[0]; return v. also add a path to emit a telemetry event when coercion happens so we can track frequency.
ci-bot: created issue #3429: "devex: js sdk helper should normalize fncall outputs + avoid stringify in retry middleware" (opened by alex)
sam_k: i'll patch sampleapp locally to handle both array and stringified-array until helper lands. maria, can you add a unit test that simulates: a) tool returns array, b) retry wraps/returns stringified array, c) validation still passes after normalize?
maria: on it. adding tests to samplekit/test/json_mode_coercion.test.ts and will include CI flag to run on node 18.
alex: opening PR now — will keep changes behind a feature flag `helpers.normalization=true` so we don't change public semantics without opt-in. will include changelog note and a short migration guide for apps relying on strict validation.
sam_k: thanks. once PR merges i'll revert the local sampleapp patch and run the samplekit e2e with `--json-mode` to confirm parity with python.
ci-bot: pipeline queued for branch alex/fncall-normalize -> build 8071 started
